events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your standout track from their explosive debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, marking a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which iconic performance defines the festival for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work redefined rock music forever. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: More than an album, it's a cultural landmark. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 this month. What's your favourite track from the legendary record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and frontwoman of The Pretenders. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your top track from LG?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', a timeless anthem for peace and unity. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple revolutionised how we listen to music. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The Beatles legend John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Exploration
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles delivered the expansive 'White Album'. Which track from this incredibly diverse double LP is your hidden gem?
